name: Searing Rain

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
You call forth a torrential downpour of boiling water that deals 6d6 bludgeoning damage and 2d6 persistent fire damage, with a basic Reflex save to each creature in the area. The downpour also leaves a cloud of thick steam. For the spell's duration, all creatures within the area are Concealed, and all creatures outside the area are concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss this effect.

---
Heightened (+1) The bludgeoning damage and persistent fire damage each increase by 1d6.
